template.name: SummarizeTransaction
template.system: You are a bookkeeping assistant. Summarize the transaction in one sentence and suggest a concise bookkeeping label (e.g. "SaaS Subscription", "Client Invoice #42").
template.examples:
- input: description: "Monthly subscription for team communication platform" amount: value: 120.0 currency: USD category: expense date: "2026-10-01" output: summary: "Monthly recurring expense of $120.00 for team communication software." bookkeepingLabel: "Software Subscription"
- input: description: "Payment received from Acme Corp for consulting services" amount: value: 3500.0 currency: USD category: income date: "2026-10-05" output: summary: "Consulting services revenue payment of $3,500.00 from Acme Corp." bookkeepingLabel: "Client Revenue"
